title: The step a Cue decision names (the `step` field of GET /cue/next)
description: Present on every Cue decision that names a step (kinds confirm, cue, ask and offer; null on kind none). Everything in it is an id or a string from the pack's own vocabulary: no page text, no model text, no screen content. `target` says where on the screen the control for the step is, so the desktop's DOM tracker can follow a ring that moved: a zone id from the pack's cog mapping (the same one the coach uses for the same step, through coach.messages.target_for) plus the pack's own label and role words for the control. It is null when the pack's mapping has no zone for the step. It is NOT the decision's own `target` ({box_2d, source, confidence}), which is the box the ring is drawn on. The Cue examples under examples/cue.decisions.example.json are generated by services/engine/understudy_engine/cue/make_examples.py and checked against this file.

id.description: A step id from the pack's expert_steps.yaml.

label.description: The pack's short label for the step (32 characters or fewer so that 'Next: ' + label fits a 40-character chip).

reason_id.description: The id of the one-line reason, from the fixed reason table.

reason_text.description: The reason's text, 12 words or fewer. Never null for a step of a shipped pack (a test checks every step of the benefits-processor, programmer and data-analyst packs).

target.description: Where the control for this step is, or null when the pack has no zone for it (the cue is then text only).

zone.description: A zone id from the pack's cog mapping (the same pattern as RectWant.zone in ext_rect.schema.json). The desktop asks the extension for the first visible element in this zone.

label_hint.description: The pack's own words for the control (the step label with its 'Open ... on calculator X' framing removed, or the pack's coach.target override). Never text read from the page.

role_hint.description: A role word: button, textbox, select or region from the coach helper, or the pack's own override (same pattern as RectWant.role).
